Privacy policy

looku Wardrobe Studio · Effective 4 November 2026

looku helps you put outfits together from clothes you own. You can add photos, try combinations and save outfits on your device. This policy explains what happens when you use those features on lookuwear.xyz or choose an online service.

Your wardrobe on this device

Your browser resizes clothing and inspiration photos and samples their colours. It stores the photos, garment names and tags, saved outfits and selected reference on this device. On-device prompts, garment matching and custom palettes are processed here. Palettes stay in the browser. The app also caches the files it needs to open offline. People who can access your browser profile may be able to see your wardrobe.

When you choose GPT styling

If you sign in with your wallet and choose Style with GPT, looku sends the text you type to OpenRouter for processing by an OpenAI model. The model returns styling preferences and a tip. The request asks that the response not be stored. Avoid including personal details in your prompt. You can use on-device styling without sending a prompt. looku matches the preferences to clothes on your device. looku does not attach wardrobe photos, saved pieces, wallet addresses or passphrases to the prompt.

When you choose an online backup

Choosing Back up online sends a snapshot of your wardrobe, saved outfits and reference to looku’s hosted storage. Your device encrypts the snapshot using the passphrase you enter. looku stores the encrypted file in private Vercel Blob storage under your signed-in wallet’s public address. The passphrase stays on your device. Keep it somewhere safe so you can restore your backup.

The online copy stays there until you replace or delete it. Removing an item locally does not change an earlier backup. To update the copy, back up again. Wallet settings, savings goals and purchase receipts are excluded from wardrobe backups.

Pinterest inspiration

Pinterest search is limited to the studio owner’s authorized account. When enabled, choosing Search Pinterest sends the words entered to Pinterest using that account. Pinterest may collect and use information in connection with that request as described in its privacy policy. Your clothing and inspiration photos stay on your device during a search.

Results may include Pin titles, identifiers, links and colours. Choosing a Pin saves its identifier, title and your chosen colour as a local reference. An optional wardrobe backup includes that reference. Opening the original Pin takes you to Pinterest. looku uses this information for outfit inspiration and does not sell Pinterest data or use it to target ads.

Wallet accounts

Creating a testnet wallet encrypts its signing key on this device. Your recovery file contains the encrypted key. To create or access a looku account, choose Sign in with this wallet. looku verifies a signature over a one-time login message and stores the public address and creation date. A private session cookie keeps you signed in for up to 12 hours. Signing out ends the session. Restoring the wallet lets you sign into the same account on another device.

Wallets, purchases and referrals

Your saved public wallet address and clothing savings goal are stored in your browser. Choosing Check balance sends the public address to the selected Stellar or Base network service. Requesting free test XLM sends the address to Stellar Friendbot. Opening MiniSend takes you to its own service, where you decide whether to supply payment details or buy funds.

For a demo purchase, your wallet asks you to authorize a payment on Stellar testnet. looku keeps an order record with the public wallet addresses, order and payment status, signed transaction information and transaction identifiers to confirm the sale, reconcile retries and track the boutique’s referral payment. Anyone with a receipt link can view its order details, including public addresses and transaction identifiers. Signed-in wallet holders can also retrieve their paid receipts. The public testnet ledger can show the addresses, amounts and transaction history. Clearing app data cannot erase published ledger entries.

The store directory links to external retailers and affiliate programs. When you follow a link, the destination receives your visit and applies its own privacy policy.

Hosting and access

Vercel hosts lookuwear.xyz and processes requests to deliver and secure the site. These requests can include your IP address, browser information and the page or endpoint requested. looku uses private Vercel Blob storage for account and session records, encrypted wardrobe backups and demo order records. The wardrobe app does not add advertising trackers.

Your choices and deletion

Use Remove on a wardrobe piece or saved outfit and Clear reference in the outfit builder to remove those items. To erase the whole local wardrobe, saved addresses, goals and local receipt history, clear the studio’s site data in your browser on each device. To delete the separate hosted snapshot, sign in and choose Wardrobe → Install looku & manage storage → Delete online backup.

You can withdraw Pinterest authorization through your Pinterest account settings. To remove a previously selected Pin, clear the reference on each device and replace or delete any online backup that contains it.

Privacy questions

For questions about your data or to request access, correction or deletion of a hosted record, email the looku operator at nzauaudrey@gmail.com. Include the feature involved and, for a test purchase, the receipt identifier. Keep wallet recovery phrases and backup passphrases private.
